dialogues.speaker: Zinenko
dialogues.text: I'm lacking in every way... What am I supposed to do?

dialogues.speaker: Zinenko
dialogues.text: *sigh* I earned very good marks in my previous exercises, which was why I had the honor of being transferred to the 1st Special Assignments Battalion.

dialogues.speaker: Zinenko
dialogues.text: But once I stood among my new comrades, I realized those scores of mine were nothing special at all.

dialogues.speaker: Zinenko
dialogues.text: Each and every one of them is like a machine in human form. No matter the mission, under Major Valeriy's command, they time everything with the precision of clockwork...

dialogues.speaker: Zinenko
dialogues.text: It's honestly exhausting just trying to keep up with them...

dialogues.speaker: Zinenko
dialogues.text: Fortunately, Major Valeriy has given me plenty of time to adjust. This is my chance to train and really sharpen myself.

dialogues.speaker: Zinenko
dialogues.text: Thank you. I'll give it everything I have!
